mails.subject: Vi har 15 vikarer klar - kan i bruge dem?
mails.body:
Hej :)

Jeg hedder Pernille og jeg skriver til mange virksomheder i København. Vi er Dansk Vikar Service og vi har lige nu 15 vikarer der kan starte med det samme, både kontor, lager og kundeservice.

Vi tager kun betaling hvis I ansætter nogen, og prisen er 210 kr i timen. Vi har ogsaa fast ansaettelse hvis i vil det.

I behøver ikke at have en stilling slået op, vi kan lave en profil til jer hvis I fortæller hvad i har brug for.

Hvis i kender nogen andre der søger folk må i gerne sende mailen videre til dem, det betyder meget for mig.

Vi har allerede hjulpet over 300 virksomheder og vores kunder er glade, det kan jeg love.

Skriv bare tilbage med hvad i mangler så vender jeg tilbage hurtigst muligt, eller ring til mig i løbet af ugen.

Mange hilsner
Pernille
Dansk Vikar Service
Sendt fra min iPhone
mails.justification: Cold staffing blast sent to many businesses by an agency with no relationship to the space.

mails.subject: Content and link package for your site: from 450 EUR
mails.body:
Dear website owner,

We are PagePeak, a link building studio, and we would like to offer you a content and link package for your coworking website.

Here is what you get for a single payment:
- 12 contextual backlinks on blogs with domain rating 40 or higher: 450 EUR
- 4 SEO optimised articles written by our team: 280 EUR
- A full technical audit of your website: 150 EUR
- Monthly ranking report: included

If you take all three, we apply a discount and the total comes to 790 EUR instead of 880 EUR. The offer is open until 15 October. Our past clients report up to 60 percent more organic traffic in three months.

We work only with real publishers and every link is manually placed. We accept bank transfer and card, and we can send the invoice right away.

To get started, just reply with the package you want and your website address. If you prefer, we can also offer a trial with 3 links for 99 EUR so you can see the quality first.

Looking forward to working with you.

Best regards,
Natalia Kovacs
Partnerships, PagePeak
mails.justification: Unsolicited paid SEO and backlink offer from a stranger.

mails.subject: Final notice: unpaid annual compliance fee
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is the final notice issued by the Danish Business Compliance Office regarding your outstanding annual compliance fee.

Our records show that no payment has been received for the registration period ending 31 October 2026. According to our general terms, an unpaid fee will result in an administrative penalty and the suspension of your business listing.

Reference number: DBCO-554-20261
Amount due: 245,00 EUR
Payment deadline: 14 October 2026

To settle the amount, please access the secure portal using the link below and enter your company credentials and the card used for registration:
http://secure.dbco-notifications.example/pay

Please do not reply to this message, as the mailbox is not monitored. Payments made after the deadline may be subject to a late fee of 60,00 EUR.

Yours faithfully,
Administration Department
Danish Business Compliance Office
mails.justification: Phishing impersonating an official-sounding compliance body with a fake fee and a credential-harvesting link.
